title: SBA Form 413 Personal Financial Statement
description: U.S. Small Business Administration Form 413, the Personal Financial Statement an applicant, owner or guarantor completes for an SBA loan, surety bond, WOSB or 8(a) program: the program it supports, the applicant and business, the assets and liabilities columns with their totals and net worth, income, contingent liabilities, and the certification.

form_edition.description: The form edition printed in the footer, e.g. 05-21 from 'SBA Form 413 (05-21)'.

omb_expiration_date.description: The OMB approval expiration date printed at the top of page 1, as YYYY-MM-DD.

programs_selected.description: Which program boxes on page 1 are checked.

loan_7a_504_surety.description: True if the '7(a) loan / 504 loan / Surety Bonds' box is checked.

disaster_business_loan.description: True if the 'Disaster Business Loan Application' box is checked.

wosb.description: True if the 'Women Owned Small Business (WOSB) Federal Contracting Program' box is checked.

business_development_8a.description: True if the '8(a) Business Development Program' box is checked.

applicant.description: The person completing the statement, from the top of page 2.

home_address.description: Home street address with city, state and ZIP code.

address.description: Business address, if different than the home address.

as_of_date.description: The date beside 'This information is current as of [month/day/year]', as YYYY-MM-DD.

assets.description: The ASSETS column on page 2, in whole dollars as numbers.

life_insurance_cash_surrender_value.description: Life Insurance - Cash Surrender Value Only.

total_assets.description: The 'Total' at the foot of the ASSETS column.

liabilities.description: The LIABILITIES column on page 2, in whole dollars as numbers.

notes_payable_to_banks_and_others.description: Notes Payable to Banks and Others.

total_liabilities.description: The 'Total Liabilities' line, not the column 'Total' below Net Worth.

total.description: The 'Total' below Net Worth, which must equal total assets.

income.description: Section 1, Source of Income, annual amounts as numbers.

contingent_liabilities.description: The Contingent Liabilities box beside Section 1, as numbers.

real_estate_owned.description: Section 4, one entry per property column (A, B, C) that has any content.

property.description: Column label: Property A, B or C.

type_of_real_estate.description: Type of Real Estate as written, e.g. Primary Residence, or N/A.

present_market_value.description: Present Market Value, if given. Null when the cell is blank.

mortgage_balance.description: Mortgage Balance, if given. Null when the cell is blank.

certification.description: The first signer block on page 4.

date.description: Date beside the signature, as YYYY-MM-DD.

signed.description: True only if a handwritten, drawn or typed signature appears on the Signature line. A blank line is unsigned: a 'SIGN' or 'sign here' flag tab printed beside the line is part of the form, not a signature.
